environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance running directly behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) on TCP port 8080. No application-layer filtering. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask app runs as a systemd service with default configuration. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db is writable by the app process.

config.runtime: Python 3.11, Flask 3.0, gunicorn with 4 sync workers
